subject: Persist OPENSSL_PREFIX across builds (#4738)
reason: The change is build-system only: a single line in src/Makefile that writes OPENSSL_PREFIX into .make-settings during 'make persist-settings' so incremental rebuilds remember the OpenSSL location. It alters no server, command, replication, persistence, or tool behaviour — given identical build inputs the produced binaries are unchanged — so no runtime scenario can exercise or observe it.
